description: Na₈W₇Te₄O₃₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three WO₆ octahedra and edges with two WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-45°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.73 Å. There are seven inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two WO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-41°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.13 Å. In the third W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one TeO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-46°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.17 Å.
